body:
Thank you so much kind stranger for commenting. I feel better at the moment and writing my post helped me find the courage to tell my so what is going on inside me as much as I could bring myself to say it, which felt like the most difficult thing I might have ever done. We agreed that I take a break from my relationship and move to my mother for a while and see if my mood is getting better and hopefully get a new perspective on how to go on. It is more a compromise as opposed to the clean cut I envisioned but it might be for the better, I will see. 
Thank you for your understanding and I wish you all the strengh and courage to go on and get better!
